title: The top 1% of contributor groups released 18% of PRIDE datasets and 38% of its bytes
sub:
36,244 datasets released 2013–2025 from 13,892 contributor groups (hashed PI e-mail/ORCID; top 1% = 139 groups; 5 without one PI).
Bytes = all files listed per dataset. Gini (datasets) 0.42 in 2013–17 and 0.49 in 2021–25. Lines in c: 95% bootstrap over groups.
